## Where

docs/how-to/write-docs.md, docs/_templates/, .claude/skills/docs/

## Goal

One writing guide that is the only home for documentation rules, one template per page kind (Diataxis plus Learn page, user-guide task, FAQ entry), and a docs skill that holds steps and links to the guide

## Done when

A page written from each template passes the docs checks unchanged
seen.title: Add the docs writing guide, page templates and docs skill
